description: Provide a city or latitude/longitude to retrieve Open-Meteo air-quality model fields: PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2 and published AQI indices. Returns units, model observation time, capture time and missing-field coverage. City lookup uses the first geocoding result; coordinates avoid ambiguity. Model output is not a local station measurement or a health assessment. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]

input.description: SYNTHORA air-quality: live air quality for any city or lat,lon — PM2.5/PM10/ozone/NO2, EU and US AQI, and a WHO-threshold operational verdict (good/moderate/harmful). Source: open-meteo Air Quality (C

name: air_quality
